direction: Calm, warm, confident educator. One continuous read, conversational pace (~150 wpm). Let sentences run into each other; small natural breaths, no robotic gaps. Slight lift on 'Now watch', settle down on 'No pulse.'

lines.text: The SA node fires, the signal travels down through the AV node, and both ventricles squeeze together.
Now watch what happens in V-fib.
The electrical activity in the ventricles turns chaotic. Instead of squeezing, they just quiver.
And with no squeeze, there's no cardiac output. No pulse.
V-fib is a shockable rhythm. Start CPR, and defibrillate as soon as possible.
Practice it on ACLSMED Sim. ACLSmed dot com.
